data.name: Description
data.value: Reusable native functions with exact contracts and versions.

data.name: BuiltInHelp
data.value: This built-in function is provisioned automatically at Instance scope and managed by the platform. Its definition is read-only.

data.name: Empty
data.value: No function has been declared in this scope.

data.name: EditorHelp
data.value: Select a native implementation. Published versions are immutable.

data.name: ImmutableHelp
data.value: Choose a new version to change the implementation. Existing versions remain available.

data.name: Error
data.value: The function could not be loaded or saved. Check its scope, native implementation and immutable version.

data.name: Native.json.select.Description
data.value: Select a JSON value at a JSON Pointer path. Returns the selected object, array or scalar as one value. An empty path selects the root; a missing path fails.

data.name: Native.json.project.Description
data.value: Build an object by selecting and renaming properties from a JSON value. Each name/path pair creates one output property. Selected arrays remain arrays inside that object.

data.name: Native.collection.filter.Description
data.value: Keep array elements whose value at the JSON Pointer path equals the supplied JSON value. Preserves input order. An empty path compares whole elements; a missing path fails.

data.name: Native.collection.distinct.Description
data.value: Remove duplicate array elements using the value at the JSON Pointer path as their key. Keeps the first occurrence and preserves input order. An empty path compares whole elements.

data.name: Native.artifact.explode.Description
data.value: Read JSON Artifact contents and prepare one publishable Artifact per array element or object value at a JSON Pointer path. Expects an Artifact manifest or an object with a content property. arrayItems preserves array order; objectValues sorts property names. Storage happens later in the publication pipeline. itemSchema validates each child; maximumOutputs defaults to 100.

data.name: JsonPointerRootHelp
data.value: An empty JSON Pointer ("") selects the JSON root. Use “Use empty text” to record that value explicitly.
